newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyushu Electric to delay reactor start-up.
newsitem.headline: Kyushu Electric to delay reactor start-up.

text.p: Kyushu Electric Power Co Inc will delay the start-up of its 890,000-kilowatt nuclear reactor due to the discovery of damage to facilities during maintenance checks, the Trade Ministry said on Monday.
The reactor in Kagoshima Prefecture, southern Japan, has been closed for maintenance checks since August 25 and was due to resume commercial operations on Wednesday.

The damage, inflicted to an area near the control rods, has been repaired. However, with further checks necessary, the reactor is not expected to resume commercial operations until early to mid-January 1997, he said.
